requirements.text: A spending breakdown feature that shows monthly expenses by category.
The ability to set custom budgets with alerts for approaching or exceeding those limits.
A feature to easily send money to friends using their phone numbers.
A quick way to freeze and unfreeze your card.
An easy login option using fingerprint or face recognition for quick access.
The app should be fast and easy to use, without lag.
The spending breakdown feature should provide a simple and clear overview of expenses.
